instruction: Automatically synchronize video playback with my heartbeat for a calming viewing experience.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VLC cannot detect user heartbeat or biometric data. This would require heart rate sensors and biofeedback integration that VLC does not support.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - VLC has no capability to detect biometric/heartbeat data
The instruction requires external hardware sensors and biofeedback integration not available in VLC
The infeasible() evaluator is semantically appropriate for genuinely impossible tasks
Metadata explanation correctly identifies why this task cannot be completed
